import json, pathlib
fp=pathlib.Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts/973f6aba-e2be-495f-bc10-a8c1c0496ee9/973f6aba-e2be-495f-bc10-a8c1c0496ee9.jsonl")
n=0
roles={}
for line in fp.open():
    o=json.loads(line)
    n+=1
    keys=list(o.keys())[:12]
    role=o.get("role") or o.get("type")
    msg=o.get("message")
    mrole=None
    clen=0
    if isinstance(msg, dict):
        mrole=msg.get("role")
        c=msg.get("content")
        clen=len(c) if isinstance(c,str) else (len(c) if isinstance(c,list) else -1)
    roles[str(role)+"|"+str(mrole)] = roles.get(str(role)+"|"+str(mrole),0)+1
    if n<=3:
        print("keys", keys, "role", role, "mrole", mrole, "clen", clen)
print("n", n, "roles", roles)
# find a line containing user_query
for i,line in enumerate(fp.open()):
    if "user_query" in line and "Oct 16" in line:
        o=json.loads(line)
        print("FOUND line", i, "top keys", o.keys())
        msg=o.get("message") or {}
        print("msg keys", msg.keys() if isinstance(msg, dict) else type(msg))
        c=msg.get("content") if isinstance(msg, dict) else None
        print("content type", type(c), "preview", str(c)[:200] if not isinstance(c, list) else c[0].keys() if c else None)
        break
else:
    print("no oct16 user_query")
    # count user_query
    c=0
    for line in fp.open():
        if "user_query" in line:
            c+=1
    print("user_query count", c)
PY
